articles.title: Kohl’s defends Kohl’s Cash, a program that boosts repeat shopping
articles.mainIdea: Kohl’s defends Kohl’s Cash, a program that boosts repeat shopping
articles.summary: TheStreet: Kohl’s defends Kohl’s Cash, a program that boosts repeat shopping. When consumers know that discounts are coming, they won't make a purchase at full price. That's why Apple only offers discounts once or twice a year. It makes the discounts special, but also forces people to make full-price purchases because they're not going to wait for a once-a-year discount. ...

articles.title: Calvert-Lewin stretches hot streak as Leeds hold Sunderland
articles.mainIdea: Calvert-Lewin stretches hot streak as Leeds hold Sunderland
articles.summary: AFP: Calvert-Lewin stretches hot streak as Leeds hold Sunderland. Dominic Calvert-Lewin scored for a sixth consecutive Premier League game as Leeds denied Sunderland a place in the top five with a 1-1 draw at the Stadium of Light on Sunday.Calvert-Lewin latched onto Brenden Aaronson's low cross for his eighth goal of the season, seven of which have come in the last six games.
